listing.name: Snowboard Kids / Snowboard Kids: Recompiled (cdlewis)
listing.summary: Use the Snowboard Kids player and select your own North American or Japanese cartridge dump on first Play.

steps.title: Select your original game on first Play
steps.instruction: Choose Play, then select your own North American or Japanese Snowboard Kids ROM in the game menu. The player checks the game identity, normalizes supported byte orders and keeps its own copy in its profile, so keep your original separately.

steps.title: Keep the complete player package
steps.instruction: For a copy you manage yourself, keep the whole player folder together: SnowboardKidsRecompiled.exe on Windows, or the native player and its folder on Linux. Flatpak and macOS application bundles keep their upstream installation and launchers. To add that copy to Portcove, select the player and its folder.

warnings: Upstream lists graphics and CPU requirements and Windows runtime prerequisites. Portcove has not observed native setup, gameplay or saves.

The package includes a modified RecompFrontend fork by cdlewis that the project license does not cover. Portcove downloads the package only from the project’s own releases. You need your own original game files.

references.title: Preserve your actual profile when updating
references.instruction: Keep the player's profile when updating: normally %LOCALAPPDATA%\SnowboardKidsRecompiled on Windows, ~/.config/SnowboardKidsRecompiled on Linux, or ~/Library/Application Support/SnowboardKidsRecompiled on macOS. It holds the copied originals, game_region.txt, saves, settings and mods, and on Windows local crash reports. On Windows and native Linux, portable.txt in the working folder stores data there instead; on macOS the marker belongs beside the application bundle. Portcove does not back up or remove the profile.

references.title: Keep Flatpak data alongside the actual profile
references.instruction: For Flatpak, also preserve the complete ~/.var/app/io.github.snowboardkidsrecomp.snowboardkidsrecomp folder. This build keeps additional writable mod data in its Flatpak data area, while the profile resolver still uses HOME/.config/SnowboardKidsRecompiled unless APP_FOLDER_PATH or portable mode selects another folder. Keep both the app data and actual profile when updating; Portcove does not back up or remove them.

presentation.manual_preparation: On first Play, select your own North American or Japanese Snowboard Kids ROM in the game menu. The player checks it and keeps a copy in its profile at %LOCALAPPDATA%\SnowboardKidsRecompiled, together with game_region.txt, saves, settings, mods and local crash reports; crash uploads are off. Keep your original separately. If the player restarts itself to change region, Portcove keeps the session open until that game closes. A copy you manage yourself without portable.txt shares the profile. Portcove refuses to start a managed copy that contains portable.txt. Portcove neither backs up nor removes the profile, and rollback does not rewind it; back it up before changing versions. Portcove replaces the player; you own the originals and the profile.
